rationale: Standalone private-bank disclosure tree with stable URLs and EN mirror; no siblings on domain.
Authoritative NBU bank ownership register, continuously updated; core to keeping the UA bank actor list correct.
Cbonds issuer profile is useful for ratings/bond cross-checks but access status unknown and largely paywalled.
Single-entity page on clarity-project.info; monitor the aggregator/parent rather than this EDRPOU file.
One bank profile among 45 siblings on minfin.com.ua; covered by monitoring the portal parent.
Tascombank ESG/reporting newsroom is the disclosure channel for the izibank/Sportbank neobank cluster.
Live regulated-information filing stream for issuers incl. banks; the primary A1 monitoring feed for Ukraine.
Machine-readable NSSMC open-data API — cleanest bulk ingestion path for issuer disclosures.
ESCRIN quarterly/special disclosure system gives higher-frequency layer above annual bank reporting.
Licence-clean bulk open-data mirror of the securities disclosure database; versioned ingestion without scraping.
Ownership/large-stake API reveals beneficial control and group structure at bank and payments issuers.
SMIDA owners database adds historical periodisation of stake changes complementing the NSSMC API.
Violations database is a recurring compliance/governance-risk signal on issuers within the disclosure perimeter.
Licensed professional-participant register — mine once for bank-affiliated traders, custodians and audit firms.
Regulator's own site publishes decisions, prospectus approvals and enforcement ahead of database entries.
Static procedural page describing prospectus approval; reference material, not a recurring signal producer.
Binding disclosure regulation — schema/deadline authority for parsers, but a fixed legal artefact.
XML schema/field dictionary needed to parse issuer filings; one-off technical artefact, not a feed.
Pre-2021 regulated-information archive needed for multi-year bank issuer time series.
Filer-side cabinet requiring credentials; contributes no public content of its own.
Bulletin registry is a minor SMIDA sub-database with low current value; covered by the SMIDA parent.
SMIDA operator news gives early warning of schema/system changes that break ingestion.
Archived regulator page useful only for link-rot resolution; verification failed, recheck before dropping.
NBU payment-infrastructure oversight hub — annual reports and the important-PSP list; core payments coverage.
NBU payments statistics hub provides the market denominators for card, e-money and terminal data.
Single NBU resolution PDF; valuable evidence on PSP reporting duties but not a standalone monitored feed.
Statutory basis for payment institution/e-money licensing categories; fixed legal text, cite as evidence.
